LESSON: POPULATION DISTRIBUTION IN EASTERN AFRICA

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: SOCIAL STUDIES
Strand: PEOPLE, POPULATION AND SOCIAL ORGANISATIONS
Topic 2.2: Population distribution in Eastern Africa

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Population distribution in Eastern Africa. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: Why are some parts of Eastern Africa more populated than others?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. explain factors influencing population distribution in Eastern Africa
2. explain effects of high population density in Eastern Africa

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE STUDYING: POPULATION DISTRIBUTION IN EASTERN AFRICA
Subject: SOCIAL STUDIES · Grade: Grade 6
This is a learner study lesson (not a teacher guide). Read every part, follow the models, then practise.

BIG PICTURE
Population distribution in Eastern Africa helps you succeed in SOCIAL STUDIES. You will understand it, practise it, and use it in your county, school, and Kenyan community.

KEY FACTS: POPULATION DISTRIBUTION IN EASTERN AFRICA
Good citizens follow rules, respect others, and care for shared places.
Kenyan examples: lining up, keeping the compound clean, telling the truth, helping a classmate.
Rights come with responsibilities.

PART 1: Explain factors influencing population distribution in Eastern Africa

What this means
In this part you learn to explain factors influencing population distribution in Eastern Africa. You will use ideas from in your county, school, and Kenyan community.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: explain factors influencing population distribution in Eastern Africa.
2. Locate, explain, then act responsibly using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Locate: Connect “Population distribution in Eastern Africa” to a real place or group in Kenya (school, market, county office, home).

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can explain factors influencing population distribution in Eastern Africa. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 2: Explain effects of high population density in Eastern Africa

What this means
In this part you learn to explain effects of high population density in Eastern Africa. You will use ideas from in your county, school, and Kenyan community.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: explain effects of high population density in Eastern Africa.
2. Locate, explain, then act responsibly using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Explain: Give one cause and one effect linked to Population distribution in Eastern Africa.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can explain effects of high population density in Eastern Africa. Write or say your answer clearly.

PUT IT TOGETHER
Close your notes and say aloud: what Population distribution in Eastern Africa is, one example, and one way you will practise this week.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Good citizens follow rules, respect others, and care for shared places.

Kenyan examples: lining up, keeping the compound clean, telling the truth, helping a classmate.

Example 1: Connect “Population distribution in Eastern Africa” to a real place or group in Kenya (school, market, county office, home). (skill: explain factors influencing population distribution in Eastern Africa)

Example 2: Give one cause and one effect linked to Population distribution in Eastern Africa. (skill: explain effects of high population density in Eastern Africa)

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach Population distribution in Eastern Africa to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: explain factors influencing population distribution in Eastern Africa.
3. Practise this skill: explain effects of high population density in Eastern Africa.
4. Make one local Kenya example of Population distribution in Eastern Africa from your county, market, farm, or school.
5. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for Population distribution in Eastern Africa: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a Grade 6 learner study Population distribution in Eastern Africa?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why are some parts of Eastern Africa more populated than others?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Know what Population distribution in Eastern Africa means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
4. Be able to: explain factors influencing population distribution in Eastern Africa.
5. Be able to: explain effects of high population density in Eastern Africa.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.
